author: JerryRigEverything
description:
Today we find out if the Pixel 11 Pro XL 'anti scratch' coating actually works. Get your own device some protection with dbrands Grip case and Prism Screen Protector here: http://dbrand.com/shop/pixel-11  Taking apart the Pixel 11 Pro XL is actually pretty easy.  Google has designed their phones to be pretty repairable.  Yeah  - you'll still need a heatgun and a really thin pry tool to get the front screen or back glass off - but once thats gone - the Pixel 11 Pro is again probably one of the most repairable smartphones of the year. 

Get my smartphone repair tool kit here: http://www.iFixit.com/JerryRig
title: They said it was going to be durable... Pixel 11 Pro XL Teardown
